_prefix: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $N, true) IS NULL; -- tenant from validated workflow data, never free text

Manual test input.query: SELECT id AS tenant_id, 'manual-test' AS source_id, 'm' || to_char(clock_timestamp(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSMS') AS period, 'v1' AS input_version, 'ok' AS scenario FROM origin_list_automation_tenants() ORDER BY (id LIKE 'tenant_test%') DESC, id LIMIT 1

Load recovery job.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true) IS NULL; SELECT tenant_id, job_key, payload, true AS recovery FROM jobs WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND job_key = $2 AND job_type = 'recovery'

Create job (idempotent).query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true) IS NULL; INSERT INTO jobs (tenant_id, job_key, job_type, payload, max_attempts) VALUES ($1, $2, 'recovery', $3::jsonb, 3) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, job_key) DO UPDATE SET job_key = jobs.job_key RETURNING id

Claim job.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $2, true) IS NULL; WITH next AS (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE tenant_id = $2 AND job_key = $3 AND ((status IN ('queued','failed') AND run_after <= now()) OR (status = 'running' AND lease_expires_at < now()))  AND attempt_count < max_attempts FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'running', lease_owner = $1, lease_expires_at = now() + interval '60 seconds', attempt_count = j.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = now() FROM next WHERE j.id = next.id RETURNING j.id, j.tenant_id, j.job_key, j.attempt_count

Record completed job.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $2, true) IS NULL; WITH u AS (UPDATE jobs SET status = 'completed', result = $5::jsonb, attempt_count = $3::int, completed_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $4 AND status = 'running' RETURNING id, tenant_id) INSERT INTO job_attempts (job_id, tenant_id, attempt_no, worker_id, outcome, finished_at) SELECT id, tenant_id, $3::int, $4, 'completed', now() FROM u ON CONFLICT (job_id, attempt_no) DO NOTHING RETURNING job_id

Log attempt 1 failed.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $2, true) IS NULL; INSERT INTO job_attempts (job_id, tenant_id, attempt_no, worker_id, outcome, error, finished_at) SELECT $1::bigint, $2, $3::int, $4, 'failed', $5, now() WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $4 AND status = 'running') ON CONFLICT (job_id, attempt_no) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

Log attempt 2 failed.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $2, true) IS NULL; INSERT INTO job_attempts (job_id, tenant_id, attempt_no, worker_id, outcome, error, finished_at) SELECT $1::bigint, $2, $3::int, $4, 'failed', $5, now() WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $4 AND status = 'running') ON CONFLICT (job_id, attempt_no) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

Dead-letter job.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $2, true) IS NULL; WITH u AS (UPDATE jobs SET status = 'dead', attempt_count = $3::int, last_error = $5, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $4 AND status = 'running' RETURNING id, tenant_id), a AS (INSERT INTO job_attempts (job_id, tenant_id, attempt_no, worker_id, outcome, error, finished_at) SELECT id, tenant_id, $3::int, $4, 'dead', $5, now() FROM u ON CONFLICT (job_id, attempt_no) DO NOTHING) INSERT INTO notifications (tenant_id, job_id, reason) SELECT tenant_id, id, 'Job ' || $6::text || ' failed after 3 attempts and was dead-lettered: ' || $5 FROM u ON CONFLICT (job_id, reason) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

Renew lease before attempt 2.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $2, true) IS NULL; UPDATE jobs SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_expires_at = now() + interval '60 seconds', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $3 AND status = 'running' AND lease_expires_at > now() AND attempt_count < max_attempts RETURNING id

Renew lease before attempt 3.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $2, true) IS NULL; UPDATE jobs SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_expires_at = now() + interval '60 seconds', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $3 AND status = 'running' AND lease_expires_at > now() AND attempt_count < max_attempts RETURNING id

Store new observations.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true) IS NULL; INSERT INTO observations (tenant_id, external_id, dedupe_key, source, title, body, fetched_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, dedupe_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, tenant_id, dedupe_key, COALESCE(body, '') AS body

Store analysis job.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true) IS NULL; INSERT INTO jobs (tenant_id, job_key, job_type, status, attempt_count, result, completed_at) VALUES ($1, $2, 'analysis', 'completed', 1, $3::jsonb, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, job_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, tenant_id, job_key

Create internal notification.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true) IS NULL; INSERT INTO notifications (tenant_id, job_id, reason) VALUES ($1, $2::bigint, $3) ON CONFLICT (job_id, reason) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

Log tenant failure.query: SELECT 1 WHERE set_config('app.tenant_id', $1, true) IS NULL; INSERT INTO automation_errors (tenant_id, workflow, item_key, message) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, workflow, item_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

Write heartbeat.query: (unchanged: heartbeat_log is system data without tenant)
